temporal_scope: Undated positive county aggregate retained in the EDDMapS snapshot retrieved 2026-04-26T09:34:15.599Z; it supports historical recorded presence only.
spatial_scope: The retained EDDMapS aggregate reports one or more verifier-reviewed or expert positive records for exact county FIPS 17203.
caveats: The retained aggregate does not expose individual occurrence dates or occurrence identifiers.
The evidence supports recorded presence only, not current establishment, abundance, or complete county distribution.
Missing rows and source silence never support absence, non-detection, applicability, or completed research.
notes: Provider citation: EDDMapS. 2026. Early Detection & Distribution Mapping System. The University of Georgia - Center for Invasive Species and Ecosystem Health. Available online at https://www.eddmaps.org/.
